name: hotel-reservation-management-system
description: Full-stack hotel reservation and management system (Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL, deployed on Cloudflare)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix infrastructure/cloudflare/workers
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix frontend && npm run type-check --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
